evidence: The growth cycle consists of precursor exposures and N2 purge following the sequence of DEZn/N2/H2O/N2 with corresponding duration of 5 s/15 s/15 s/5 s. After each N2 purging, the reactor was pumped down to ∼1×10-2 Torr. Precursor introduction was done by opening the inlet valve between the reservoir and reactor chamber while the outlet valve was closed; no carrier gas was employed.
